name: Book Recs
about: Recommends books for a title, a genre or a mood, from a book recommendation service.

settings.name: server
settings.label: Service address
settings.obtain: The https address of a running book recommendation service (services/book-recommender in thooton/wave), with or without /v1/recommendations at its end.

settings.name: token
settings.label: Service token
settings.obtain: Only if the service was started with WAVE_BOOK_RECS_TOKEN: the same value. It is sent as a bearer token. This is the service's own token, never an OpenRouter key.

limits: Prompts are sent to the service you set up, which asks OpenRouter and an ISBN database for books; its owner pays for the OpenRouter requests.

delta.about: Book Recs talks to its recommendation service directly; there is no Delta backend.
